body:
case file: the hidden messages that told one continuous story.

for five albums, taylor hid secret messages in her lyric booklets -- spelled out in the capitalized letters, a scavenger hunt fans learned to read line by line. on 1989 she flipped it. the codes moved to the *lowercase* letters. new sound, new cipher.

and this time they weren't thirteen separate clues. read in track order, the thirteen messages tell one continuous story -- a two-year autobiography threaded through the lyric sheets. billboard decoded the full set the week the album dropped. it opens: "we begin our story in new york."

it was also the finale. the booklet codes stop completely at reputation. 1989 was the last scavenger hunt of its kind.
